verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a headless CLI with batch conversion and printing (--convert-to, --print-to-file, --cat), so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers exit-code semantics, failure signaling, or structured logging that would let a pipeline tell success from failure. CLI existence and batch modes are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the tool returns meaningful exit codes and logs, so a pipeline can tell success from failure without parsing prose
